# ns-frame

> Tiny (11 KB gzip core), dependency-free library for native UI shapes on the web: bevels, notches, scoops, squircles and fillets on any corner of any element via a small shape language in HTML attributes (`data-ns="tl+br bevel 18; radius 3"`), with borders that follow the cut (`--ns-border`), geometry morphing, shape-preserving apertures, shaped components (toasts, carousel, skeletons, popovers, View Transitions, draggable sheet, navigation island), free-form mosaics, concentric corners, text that fills a shape, multi-line highlights, liquid (gooey) groups, materials (refractive glass with a real lens, draggable glass tabs, lit relief) and build-time compilation to CSS `shape()`. Strict-CSP safe, accessible, Apache-2.0. Docs are in Spanish.

Install: not on npm yet (any npm package named ns-frame is not ours). Load `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kodecagency/ns-frame@v0.18.1/packages/ns-frame/dist/ns-frame.js`; modules come from the same `dist/` folder and version (`dist/ns-toast.js`…).

Key rules: import the core once (`import 'ns-frame'`); never use CSS `border` on shaped elements (use `--ns-border`); use `data-ns-pad` for text containers; optional modules are imported by path (`ns-frame/toast`, `ns-frame/vt`…); verify with `audit({ clearance: 5 })` from `ns-frame/audit`.

Modules (each loads only what it needs; most start from their attribute): `ns-frame` / `ns-frame/lite` (shapes, borders, morph, apertures: `data-ns`), `ns-frame/fx` + `ns-fx.css` (U-light, aura, patterns, animated text), `ns-frame/glass` (`data-ns-glass`), `ns-frame/liquid` (`data-ns-liquid`; also `data-ns-drops`, a button that releases its actions as liquid drops), `ns-frame/tabs` (`data-ns-tabs`; readable text on glass by default), `ns-frame/relief` (`data-ns-relief`), `ns-frame/light` (shared page light, internal), `ns-frame/isle` (`isle(el)`: nav capsule that morphs into a sheet; ready-made look), `ns-frame/sheet` (`sheet(el)`), `ns-frame/toast` (`toast(msg)`), `ns-frame/pop` (popovers/tooltips), `ns-frame/carousel` (`data-ns-carousel-current` morphs the centered slide), `ns-frame/controls` (ready-made segmented controls, chips, fields, sliders and swatches: `data-ns-segment`, `data-ns-chips`, `data-ns-field`, `data-ns-range`, `data-ns-swatches`; themed with `--ns-ui-*`), `ns-frame/skel` (skeletons), `ns-frame/mosaic`, `ns-frame/bento`, `ns-frame/concentric`, `ns-frame/flow`, `ns-frame/mark`, `ns-frame/link` (HUD callouts), `ns-frame/vt` (View Transitions), `ns-frame/css` / `ns-frame/static` / `ns-frame/astro` (build-time CSS `shape()`), `ns-frame/audit` (dev). The core also ships `data-ns-choice` (button groups with arrow keys and a `change` event; `<select data-ns-choice-for="id">` mirrors a group both ways), `modal()` (native `<dialog>` with shape-aware open/close), `jump()` (reliable in-page jump) and `watch()` (auto-mount/unmount by attribute); `ns-frame/mosaic` has `arrange()` (template change with View Transitions). Low-end devices: `quality()` returns `high` or `low` (auto from device memory, cores, save-data and measured frames; or fixed with `<html data-ns-quality>`); in `low` glass is native blur + tint + rim only (no lens map, no WebGL). Naming: `--ns-<module>-time` (accepts `320`, `320ms` or `.32s`), `-ease`, `-radius`, `-width`, `-ink` (text color), `-fill`/`-bg`. Old names still work as aliases: `--ns-mark-round`, `--ns-sk-time`, `--ns-round*`, `--ns-orb-round`, `--ns-mo-*` (now `--ns-mosaic-*`, effect time `--ns-mosaic-fx-time`). They combine: one element can carry a shape, glass and fx classes; glass follows its shape during a morph; glass and relief share one light; apertures (`open`/`data-ns-open`) do not clip glass (clip-path would isolate its backdrop).

## Docs (Spanish)

- [Introducción](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/introduccion.md)
- [Instalación](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/instalacion.md): CDN (jsDelivr), import maps, bundlers, Astro, React, Vue, Svelte
- [Sintaxis de formas](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/sintaxis.md)
- [Estilo y bordes](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/estilo.md)
- [Movimiento](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/movimiento.md)
- [Layout](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/layout.md)
- [Mosaico](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/mosaico.md): `ns-frame/mosaic` — free-form bento (L/T/U pieces with a constant gap), shaped orbs (circle, hex, diamond, triangle) that cut their neighbours and can hold content, connected light effects via `data-ns-mosaic`
- [Componentes](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/componentes.md): popovers, toasts, carousel, skeletons, View Transitions, `ns-frame/sheet`, `ns-frame/isle` (a nav capsule that morphs into its sheet like a phone status island), callouts, and what CSS can't do yet: `ns-frame/concentric` (`data-ns-concentric`), `ns-frame/flow` (`data-ns-flow`), `ns-frame/mark` (`data-ns-mark`), `ns-frame/liquid` (`data-ns-liquid`; `="glass"` for refractive glass with a lens in every engine), `ns-frame/glass` (`data-ns-glass`: refractive glass on any element with its exact ns-frame shape or border-radius, ready to use with no variables; real lens in every engine — native in Chromium, WebGL in Safari/iOS/Firefox over images, video or the page itself; adapts its tone to what passes behind and exposes `--ns-glass-ink` for text; `facet` = cut glass, `prism` = chromatic dispersion; many pieces: `data-ns-glass-group` on their container renders them all in one pass — a WebGL2 engine over a known backdrop (child img/video/canvas, CSS `url()` background or a selector), a single union lens in Chromium over the page, a shared blur layer elsewhere; tune with `--ns-glass-lens`, `-depth`, `-group-blur`, `-sat`, `-dispersion`, `-rim`), `ns-frame/relief` (`data-ns-relief`: opaque materials with real volume computed from the shape, lit per pixel; controls sink when pressed / aria-pressed / aria-checked), `ns-frame/tabs` (`data-ns-tabs`, glass tabs whose indicator can be dragged)
- [Controles](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/controles.md): ready-made controls from `ns-frame/controls` on native HTML — segmented and chips (`data-ns-segment`, `data-ns-chips` with `data-ns-choice`), fields and textareas (`data-ns-field`), sliders with live output (`data-ns-range`), vertical glass levels with a drag gesture that works on iOS (`data-ns-level`), switches (`data-ns-switch`), copy buttons with aria-live (`data-ns-copy="#id"`), badges (`data-ns-badge`), code blocks (`data-ns-code`), card buttons (`data-ns-card`), grips (`data-ns-grip`), check lists (`data-ns-checks`), avatar stacks (`data-ns-avatars`) and swatches; themed with `--ns-ui-*`, CSS in `@layer ns` so any rule of yours wins
- [Efectos](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/efectos.md)
- [Formas sin JS](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/sin-js.md)
- [API de JavaScript](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/api.md)
